rounds.text: Conceded: [E6], [E7], [E13]. Despite headline profitability metrics, Digikore Studios Ltd carries severe financial and structural risks that are entirely unmasked by headline earnings. Most alarmingly, cash generation has completely disconnected from reported profit, evidenced by a dismal cash conversion of -0.75x and negative operating cash flow of Rs -6.38 Cr in Mar 2026 [E22, E23]. This cash drain extends to a free cash flow deficit of Rs -8.03 Cr, leaving operating cash flow at -35% of operating profit [E24, E25]. Compounding this liquidity pressure, the company carries heavy financial leverage with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.24x as borrowings climbed to Rs 54.11 Cr [E26, E27], while high debtors stretch to an alarming 354 days [E51]. Insider confidence is heavily deteriorating as promoter holdings dropped to 58.46% [E29] with an extreme 86.5% of their remaining shares pledged [E50], accompanied by a complete exit of domestic institutional investors to 0.00% [E31]. Finally, market sentiment reflects severe structural rejection, with the stock pinned at the very bottom of its 52-week range [E5, E36], sitting -74.8% away from its high [E37] below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E38] with an abysmal relative-strength rating of 0 [E39].

evidence.quote: And our goal over the next year, that is by the end of FY ‘27, is to be at 80% direct work and we are moving in that direction pretty well.

evidence.fact: The company is committed to sustaining a 30% plus CAGR over the next few years.
evidence.quote: We are committed to sustaining 30% plus CAGR over the next few years, supported by industry tailwinds, our sales engine, technology leverage and a sharper client mix.

evidence.fact: Management anticipates VFX margins will settle in the 16% to 18% range.
evidence.quote: Going forward, I anticipate VFX will settle in the same range of 16% to 18%.

evidence.fact: Independent trackers point to animation and VFX growing at a 12.12% CAGR through 2030.
evidence.quote: For example, one recent market view animation and VFX at a 12.12% CAGR through 2030, underpinned by streamer demand, real-time pipelines, and cloud rendering.

evidence.fact: Virtual production is projected to compound at between 18% and 33% CAGR by 2030.
evidence.quote: Within this, virtual production is expanding even faster with estimates ranging from 18% to 33% CAGR for virtual production by 2030, reflecting the shift to LED volumes and on-set visualization in real-world shoots.

evidence.fact: Episodic content accounts for 80% of company revenue, providing pipeline visibility and consistent cash conversion.
evidence.quote: Today, 80% of our revenue is episodic, which provides pipeline visibility, seasonality balance, and more consistent cash conversion relative to one-off terms.

evidence.fact: The board approved establishing a subsidiary in New York to anchor North America growth.
evidence.quote: We have just got approval from our board, and we are working towards establishing a subsidiary in New York, basically to anchor North America growth and response time.

evidence.fact: Virtual production asset library items are monetizing on Unreal Engine's fab.com.
evidence.quote: More importantly, our VP asset library is already monetizing on Unreal Engine's fab.com, and we are seeing growing revenues from fab.com month-on-month, which is a great sign.

evidence.fact: Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue fell to 78.6% from 83% in H1 FY26.
evidence.quote: operating expenses as a percentage of revenue fell to 78.6% from 83%, an improvement of 440 bps on a mix, utilization and cost control.

evidence.fact: International streaming platforms and production companies are currently averse to using AI in content production.
evidence.quote: As of today, international streaming platforms, international production companies like Netflix, Amazon, Disney, Warner, Marvel, they are yet averse to using AI in content production.

evidence.quote: We are actively leveraging AI to boost internal VFX productivity and reduce turnaround times — enhancing margins and scalability.

evidence.quote: We are today sitting in an order book of over INR20 crores, and we'll definitely keep this momentum, more meetings, more demos, more wins, because it's a no-brainer.

evidence.fact: Direct work share has increased, with the company achieving almost a 50:50 ratio of direct work.
evidence.quote: This year, we have achieved almost 50:50 ratio, which is 50% direct work compared to last year, which was only 20% direct work.

evidence.fact: The current bidding pipeline holds over INR35 crores worth of projects.
evidence.quote: So, currently, we have almost -- I don't have the exact figure, but if you're asking bidding, what is in bidding, we have over INR35 crores worth of projects in bidding.

evidence.fact: The company is completing a INR45 crore QIP fundraise in November.
evidence.quote: On capital and balance sheet, again a very important part of any business, we will be completing our INR45 crore QIP fundraise in November.

evidence.quote: Following the QIP, the promoters also intend to infuse INR20 crore via convertible warrants.

And they are not yet ready to use AI in their production pipeline, the actual, what we call a generative AI, that is creating images or creating videos using AI, because they are extremely scared, extremely conservative of copyright.
